CustomField.description: Per-template "Hide Decline Button" switch (#367). Unchecked (the default) — the signer's "Decline to Sign" button shows on this template's signing pages. Check it to hide Decline for this template's signature requests, e.g. formal or binding documents where a self-serve refusal isn't wanted. The org-wide switch (Signature_Hide_Decline__c on DocGen_Settings__c) hides Decline everywhere regardless of this field. Requests with no template (raw source-document sends) are gated by the org-wide switch alone.
CustomField.label: Hide Decline Button
